name: echo-notes
description: Dictate therapy sessions; get audit-ready progress notes ready to paste into your EHR.

scripts.build:transcriber: swift build -c release --arch arm64 --package-path native/transcriber && mkdir -p native/transcriber/dist && cp "$(swift build -c release --arch arm64 --package-path native/transcriber --show-bin-path)/EchoTranscriber" native/transcriber/dist/
scripts.package: npm run build:transcriber && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac --dir
scripts.dist: npm run build:transcriber && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.release: npm version patch -m "Release %s" && npm run publish:mac && git push --follow-tags
scripts.publish:mac: npm run build:transcriber && electron-vite build && GH_TOKEN=$(gh auth token) electron-builder --mac --publish always

extendInfo.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Echo uses the microphone so you can dictate session summaries.
extendInfo.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Echo receives the dictations you record on your iPhone over your local network.
